akhfash:2-2.t: He said ﴿يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجاً﴾: their singular is الفَوْج (a troop).

akhfash:3-3.t: And He said ﴿َفسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ﴾: He means "let your glorification be with praise" (يَكُونُ تسبيحُك بالحَمْد), because "التَسْبيح" (glorification) is remembrance (dhikr); so He said: "let your remembrance be with praise for what I have given you, the conquest of Mecca and other things". And a man says "قَضَيْتُ سُبْحتي من الذكر" ("I have completed my subḥa of remembrance").
